items.finding: For each original leaf v with support s, H=T-{v,s}, W=N_T(s)\{v}, and R=T-N_T[s]=H-W. Independent j-sets in H partition into sets meeting W and sets avoiding W; the latter are precisely independent j-sets in R. Therefore q_j=i_j(H)-i_j(R) counts those meeting W, and Delta_(p-1)(H)-Delta_(p-1)(R)=q_p-q_(p-1). This is an identity and yields no aggregate sign.

This arithmetic explains a possible exact-order match but does not extend such a result to arbitrary target orders. The source-specific lemma hypothesis and proof were not independently accessed.
